## Button
**Node ID:** 9:102

Button — the ONE text button. Kind primary (the single filled accent CTA per screen) / secondary (outlined) / ghost (no fill) / destructive / link (no fill, on-dark blue label — toast + popover link actions only). Size xs 24 (size/icon-lg; pad 2/8; ui/11 caption medium — inline panel actions such as &amp;quot;✦ AI&amp;quot;) / sm 28 (height/button-panel — panel &amp;amp; drawer footers, toasts) / md 32 (height/button-chrome — topbar, dialog footers) / lg 36 (size/control-md; pad 6/14; ui/14 panel title — workspace CTAs). State rest / hover / focus / disabled / loading (sm/md only; xs/lg/link ship rest only). Radius radius/control-panel 6 (sm/xs) · radius/control 8 (md/lg). Props: Label:T, Icon:I (leading 16 px icon slot, icon/plus-16 default), Show icon:B (off by default). Use for: every labelled button. Do not use for: icon-only controls (→ IconButton), tabs (→ Tab), chips (→ Chip). Never resize an instance off-set — pick the Size variant. 21 Sep (L2c): Size=xl (44 h size/header, pad 18, ui/14 — workspace hero CTAs) for Kind primary / secondary / ghost / destructive × rest; Kind=split Size=md / lg (primary look: label · 1 px white 30 % divider · chevron-down caret 16 — the Upload ▾ split trigger; override fills to color/ink for the dark Media Upload). Kind=ai Size=xs (accent-tint fill, accent-text "✦ AI" — the Inspector / Panel header AI trigger, no overrides needed). VARIANTS POLICY (21 Sep 2026, DS audit): interaction-state variants (hover · focus · disabled · loading · open · dragging) are kept for hand-off even where the prototype instantiates 0 of them; they are not pruned. Size/Kind variants exist only where the design uses them.
